cluster.family_skeleton: one institution's running count published as the count, without the two other counts that disagree with it and without the method that separates them

members.headline: Kepala BGN: Korban Keracunan MBG Capai 6.517 Orang Sejak Januari 2025
members.note: Verbatim title from content/sources.json (id-cnn-bgn-poisoning-6517). BGN counting incidents in its own program: the figure ships flagged self_reported.

members.headline: Beda Data KLB Keracunan MBG: BPOM vs BGN
members.note: Verbatim title from content/sources.json (id-bloombergtechnoz-bpom-9089). Carries the BPOM count of 9,089 as a direct quote of Taruna Ikrar. The 9,083 variant reported by one outlet does not ship; the 4,711 figure the PRD carried was never verified and does not ship at all.

members.headline: Data JPPI: Per September, 8.649 Anak Keracunan MBG
members.note: Verbatim title from content/sources.json (id-cnn-jppi-8649). The third count, from a civil-society network. The three are never reconciled, which is the dueling panel.

label.en: The MBG free meal program operates at national scale
label.id: Program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) beroperasi dalam skala nasional

label.en: Recipients, most of them schoolchildren, suffer food poisoning after the meals
label.id: Penerima program, sebagian besar anak sekolah, mengalami keracunan makanan setelah menyantap menu MBG

label.en: BGN, the agency running the program, announces its own running count of the victims
label.id: BGN, badan yang menjalankan program itu, mengumumkan hitungan berjalan versinya sendiri atas jumlah korban

label.en: The agency's announced figure stands as the full national scale of the harm
label.id: Angka yang diumumkan badan itu menjadi ukuran utuh skala keracunan secara nasional
